title: Unary search orbit
statement: For every binary string $w$ and natural number $i\le |w|+1$, iterating the search round $i$ times from the empty string yields the string consisting of $i$ copies of $1$.
replaced: For every word $w$ and every $i \le |w| + 1$, iterating the search round $i$ times from the empty state yields the all-ones word of length $i$.
